annotations.title: Create a free AnyHook endpoint (no account needed)

description: Zero-config bootstrap: creates a free ephemeral relay endpoint + API key with no signup. Returns inbound_url (receives webhooks immediately), api_key, and claim_url. Relay claim_url to your user before the session ends, unclaimed workspaces self-delete in 7 days. This MCP session auto-connects to the new account; remote tools work right after. Endpoint expires in 7 days unless claimed.

destination_url.description: Optional forwarding destination for the new endpoint.

source.description: Optional provider name (stripe, github, shopify, ...). Leave it out to accept any sender: naming one makes the edge refuse (401) requests without that provider's signature header, curl tests included.

name: anyhook_quickstart
